upgrades.name: Rapid-Fire Cannons
upgrades.desc: Install an improved reload mechanism that drastically accelerates the firing rate of the primary weapon. Just fire at your problems instead of thinking too much. +50% attack rate.

upgrades.name: Large Caliber
upgrades.desc: Switch your old weapon to a 150-mm heavy cannon provided by the Federation Ordnance Department. It might not be much more powerful, but precision becomes much less of an issue. +200% bullet size.

upgrades.name: High-Density Tips
upgrades.desc: Outfit your shells with a tip of depleted uranium, allowing it to go through enemy armor. Federation Command recommends to remove the radiation detector from your cabin to avoid annoying sounds. Bullets pierce one enemy and strike the next.

upgrades.name: Unobtanium Payload
upgrades.desc: Procure new shells filled with military-grade exotic matter. You don't understand the physics behind it, but your enemies die much faster. +100% attack damage.

upgrades.name: Composite Armor
upgrades.desc: Replace original metal plating with a multi-layer composite armor panels, greatly improving the ship's ability to withstand damage. +1 HP.

upgrades.name: High-Power Fuel
upgrades.desc: Fill the fuel tanks with a highly toxic and flammable but incredibly energy-dense chemical compound, which drastically increases engine performance. +50% movement speed.

upgrades.name: Survival Systems
upgrades.desc: Overhaul internal workings of the ship for greater redundancy, allowing the ship to function perfectly with as little as 32% hull integrity, 66% engine output or 50% of pilot limbs remaining. +1 HP.

upgrades.name: Generator Matrix
upgrades.desc: Install an experimental matrix that can automatically raise shields. Powered through excess main reactor output that was previously radiated into space. Automatically creates a Shield every 15 seconds.

upgrades.name: Efficient Coolant
upgrades.desc: Add a state-of-the-art heat disposal system that allows you to negate the energy cost of cooling the Laser, substantially increasing battery life. +100% Laser active time.

upgrades.name: Repurposed ICBM
upgrades.desc: Reuse old decommissioned planet-based ballistic missiles to store your nuclear armaments. Allows to store one Nuclear Bomb until the end of the level. Press X to detonate the stored bomb.

upgrades.name: Use More Gun
upgrades.desc: As a wise man said - when enemies are everywhere, SHOOT EVERYWHERE. Multi-Fire fires in six directions instead of three.

upgrades.name: Thermonuclear Bomb
upgrades.desc: When two hydrogen atoms meet each other and fall in love, their love becomes the most powerful force in the universe. Unleash it upon your enemies. Nuclear Bomb +300% damage, damages all enemies on screen.

upgrades.name: Engineer Training
upgrades.desc: Attend engineer training courses and learn how to properly apply the instruments you may find in a Repair Kit. Repair Kit restores +100% HP.

upgrades.name: Plasma Mines
upgrades.desc: Replace the outdated high explosive payload in your Mines with a new plasma ejection system. The newer system delivers just as much devastation in an increased radius. Mine explosion radius +100%.

upgrades.name: Hardened Shield
upgrades.desc: Replace cheap original wiring in your shield generator with actually good components that can handle a little overload. +200% Shield durability.

upgrades.name: Nanobot Integration
upgrades.desc: Integrate a nanobot reconstruction system into your Repair Kits, allowing you to completely return the ship into brand new state from any degree of damage. Repair Kit restores all HP immediately.
